## Financial authority: bank instruction annex

Donor: ⟦PERSON|Orrisa Fenwick⟧

Attorney: ⟦PERSON|Lennor Ruskale⟧

The donor authorises the attorney to obtain statements and arrange payment of the household invoices listed in the signed schedule. This annex identifies the bank account concerned. It does not permit borrowing, opening an additional account or adding another account holder.

**Bank account:** ⟦BANK|47-29-16/00318572⟧

Before arranging a payment, the attorney must compare the invoice against the approved schedule and record the amount paid. A supplier's request to change payment instructions requires independent confirmation. The attorney must not infer approval merely because a different destination appears on a later copy of an invoice.

The donor's ordinary correspondence address is ⟦ADDRESS|28 Spindle Row, Lancaster⟧. Notices concerning this annex may also be sent to ⟦EMAIL|orrisa.instructions@spindle-row.invalid⟧.

The initial payment limit is GBP 600 per transaction. Any proposed payment above that limit requires the further authority described in the main instrument.

Donor's signature: ⟦PERSON|Orrisa Fenwick⟧

Attorney's acknowledgement: ⟦PERSON|Lennor Ruskale⟧

Dated 13 December 2026.
